oneLine: Roshan Dealmark promoters sell 14 lakh shares.

sources.title: Roshan Dealmark Promoters Sell 14 Lakh Shares

synopsis: Roshan Dealmark Private Limited and Puja Agarwal, belonging to the promoters and promoter group, disposed of 14,00,000 equity shares of Tavexia Lifecare Limited, representing 0.36% of the total share capital. The transaction was executed through an on-market trade on September 15, 2026. Prior to this disposal, the promoters held 1,99,29,777 shares, or 5.19% of the company, and post-transaction their holding reduced to 1,85,29,777 shares, representing 4.83% of the total share capital. No financial value or deal amount was disclosed in the report.
